details:
Lately the sound coming from players using regular voice chat has been of rather poor quality: it sounds choppy, it periodically cuts out, fills with unpleasant grinding noise, crackles, etc. I think first cases of decline of a voice chat quality for happened on October 9 and then it was fine for awhile but for the last few days it started happening more and more frequently. Here's a video from today when the voice sound worsened overtime - to the point of completely dissapearing: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NQwuE2o9F24CbSn8ZFcNHSInUgphOn1G/view?usp=sharing (2.5 min long video; file size is too big)

Yesterday the sound quelity rapidly declined closer to the evening, though it was fine for hour earlier, today it was bad right away, though seemengly it didn't affect the sound coming from all players in the instance.

However, after said rapid decline on yesterday's evening I dicided to move from a Japanese to European instance and the sound of people's voices were still crackling, other people in that instance were also complaining afterwards. So, the issue remained in both previous and current (2026.4.1) new patch.

The region is Russia which always has a lot of connection problems but while we're used to broken audio and video players choppy and juttery sound from a regular voice chat is something new. And if some video players may be fixed via VPN-like services, the quality of a sound from voice chat doesn't seem to be affected by it, doesn't matter which one do you use or if you even use any at all. So, I'm not entirely sure if it's an issue of the Russian region or people from other places experienced it too recently and there's something that VRChat can do from their side.
title: Choppy jittery audio from voice chat
